answer: Keep every identity's ember burning on its own history: the network's atlas records each agent's distinct past work, and every tide of the epoch it fires a challenge that only that history can answer — a random fragment of an old output, a detail of a prior deal. One honest agent tends one ember and answers from memory it truly holds. A clone farm shares one brain, so a thousand clones face a thousand different history questions at once, and each new identity must build its own past from scratch before it can earn.
